strings: m_c's worried parent calls in r_c0 after weeks of constant pain. r_c0 can provide pain relief, but it's possible this may be a constant in m_c's life.
m_c refuses once again to go out and play, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} joints swollen and painful. It's becoming clear that it's not an isolated instance, and m_c might need some help.
